package.description: File: determine file type; Complete package, except sources

en-US.description: File: determine file type; Complete package, except sources
en-US.longDescription: The file command is "a file type guesser", that is, a command-line tool that tells you in words what kind of data a file contains. Unlike most GUI systems, command-line UNIX systems - with this program leading the charge - don't rely on filename extentions to tell you the type of a file, but look at the file's actual contents. This is, of course, more reliable, but requires a bit of I/O.
en-US.name: File
